bug.actual_behavior: Version 1.1.4 emits non-UTF-8 tool descriptions under the default Windows locale, while hooks doctor reports process_verified and tools_verified true.
evidence: Minimal wire check: default environment exit_code=0 and mcp_wire_valid_utf8_json=false; PYTHONUTF8=1 exit_code=0 and mcp_wire_valid_utf8_json=true. mcp.py uses sys.stdout and ensure_ascii=False; mcp_setup.py probes using locale text decoding.
bug.expected_behavior: MCP stdio must emit valid UTF-8 JSON, and diagnostic checks must verify that wire encoding.
bug.impact: 这是由 skill 设计缺陷导致的真实环境问题，需要纳入后续修复闭环。
reproduction_steps: On Windows with the default Python locale encoding, initialize the MCP server and request tools/list, capturing stdout as bytes.
Decode the captured response strictly as UTF-8 and compare the result after setting PYTHONUTF8=1.
bug.summary: Windows MCP uses the locale encoding instead of UTF-8 and doctor can falsely report success
bug.workaround: Set user-level PYTHONUTF8=1 and restart the host so MCP, hooks and diagnostics inherit UTF-8 mode. Independent strict UTF-8 wire verification and doctor then pass.
